brief.prompt: A woman with a long face wears a chin-length layered bob with soft waves that add volume at cheek level and wispy curtain bangs covering part of her forehead. She sits in a bright hair salon, seen from the front at eye level, in a relaxed and natural pose.
brief.alt: Woman with an oblong face shape wearing a chin-length wavy bob with curtain bangs
brief.purpose: Illustrates the haircut principle for longer and feminine styles: horizontal volume at cheek level and a fringe that reduces visible forehead length.

review.alt: Smiling woman with a long face shape wearing a chin-length wavy brown bob with wispy curtain bangs, sitting in a bright hair salon in a cream knit sweater
